name: poof
source: round3 FX A7 (crumpled-paper puff with stars), animated as a stop-motion pop: grows in, holds, shrinks away
use: Every death ends on a crumpled paper ball; play this centred on the death's poof_center_px right after the last death frame, scaled to taste (ball_diameter_px is given), and remove the unit.
note: The brief mentioned "A6 poof"; in the locked FX set A6 is the cellophane strip used for the snail slime trail, so the poof uses A7 (the crumpled-paper puff). Easy to swap.
